purpose: Art direction and acceptance reference consumed by compiler/renderer; not itself MEDIEVAL-EPISODE props. Visual direction remains provisional until artistic pilot.

references.note: Concept reference inspected; turnaround, scale and approved production poses still need a model sheet.

typography.note: Starting values, not platform requirements. Test full compositions at 360px display width, with captions/player overlap considered. Reframe or shorten unreadable text.

art.character: Rounded white face, irregular brown hair, expressive brows/eyes/mouth, muted blue tunic, belt/pouch, thin dark limbs; match inspected C reference.
art.background: Warm illustrated setting with reduced contrast/detail around the focal action.
art.linework: Dark rounded contours; test relative weight on character, prop and background together.
art.historicalScope: Scene details require episode evidence; C costume is a guide identity, not evidence of period clothing.

motion.authoring: intent -> start state -> preparation -> action -> reaction -> end state
motion.cueBasis: narration anchors until actual audio is aligned
motion.timingNote: Optional pilot ranges; audible delivery and readable action decide final timing.

sound.mix: Set by listening in context; no universal SFX gain. Avoid stacking accents over key words. Silence is allowed.

releaseGate: Historical visual claims checked or explicitly reconstructed
Character and prop continuity checked in actual composites
Focal action readable at phone display size
Motion serves action, explanation or reaction
Voice, effects, ambience and music heard together
Actual export inspected; no false completion from plan or counters
